historical_record.description: The Goodman Building, which stood here, was built by Joseph Emeric.
The Goodman Building was remodelled to add stores and offices, to the design of the architect Conrad A. Meussdorffer; the facade was moved forward.

The Goodman Building, a low-cost haven for artists that became Theatre Rhinoceros's first home and hosted gay and lesbian cultural festivals in 1980 and 1981; threatened with demolition by the Redevelopment Agency, it was designated a San Francisco landmark (No. 71).

unknowns: The nomination dates the Goodman Building to 1869; the assessor's 2025 roll gives 1900 for the building on this parcel.
